base_value_source: TTWO Q2 FY2027 earnings release (Form 8-K Ex. 99.1), 2026-11-09, 'Outlook for Fiscal Year 2027' — derived at the guided midpoints: GAAP net revenue 8,080 less GAAP cost of revenue 3,739.5 less GAAP operating expenses 4,088 = 252.5. GAAP basis (income/(loss) from operations). NOT the company's non-GAAP EBITDA, NOT the management-reporting basis, and NOT the Capital IQ 'EBITDA' field, which is management-basis (CLAUDE.md §15).
notes: Revenue basis is GAAP total net revenue, not the company-defined Net Bookings metric (FY2027 is guided on BOTH: GAAP net revenue 7,980-8,180 and Net Bookings 8,000-8,200). Two rows below carry impact_metric because their coefficients are measured on a different metric than base_metric: recurrent_consumer_spending_growth_pp is on Net Bookings, and usd_vs_all_currencies is on GAAP net revenue. Those two must not be added to base_value.

sensitivities.label: Q3 FY27 GAAP net revenue vs the guided $3,345m midpoint (the Grand Theft Auto VI launch quarter)
sensitivities.unit: USD m of Q3 FY27 GAAP net revenue (delta vs the guided 3,345 midpoint)
sensitivities.non_linearity: ASYMMETRIC, and the asymmetry is in the accounting policy. The 0.494619 coefficient = 1 - the Q3 guided cost-of-revenue ratio of 50.538% (1,690.5/3,345), i.e. it treats cost of revenue as FULLY VARIABLE and holds operating expenses fixed at the guided 1,172. Cost of revenue is not fully variable: FY2027 cost of revenue embeds a fixed 572 of acquired-intangible amortisation and a fixed 113 of stock-based compensation, and the internally capitalised development amortisation runs at the GREATER OF revenue-proportional or straight-line over 9-36 months, so the straight-line leg keeps charging when revenue does not arrive. At the opposite bound (cost-of-revenue DOLLARS held at the guided 1,690.5) the coefficient is 1.00 per USD 1 of revenue, so a -669.0 move costs -669.0 of EBIT, not -330.9. The true downside coefficient sits between 0.494619 and 1.00 and is not disclosed: a miss is worth 1.0x to 2.0x a beat of the same size. Separately, Q3 management-basis operating expenses are guided +21% YoY on launch marketing, which is committed before sell-through is known. Also note the ratio basis: 50.538% is the Q3 guided ratio and must NOT be swapped for the FY2027 guided 46.281% or the Q2 FY27 actual 42.525%.
sensitivities.source: TTWO Q2 FY2027 earnings release (8-K Ex. 99.1), 2026-11-09, 'Fiscal Third Quarter Ending December 31, 2026' (GAAP net revenue 3,270-3,420; cost of revenue 1,649-1,732; operating expenses 1,162-1,182); amortisation policy at FY2026 Form 10-K, Note 1 (Software Development Costs and Licenses). Coefficient derived, not disclosed — the company publishes no per-unit revenue sensitivity.
sensitivities.mitigation_note: 0% management response assumed — a BOUND, not a forecast (CLAUDE.md §9). Realised offset NOT computable from the pool: the one period that tests it (Q2 FY27, where Net Bookings missed the guided midpoint by 43.7 yet GAAP EPS of $(0.29) beat the guided $(0.84)-$(0.75)) was helped by a 57.9 benefit from income taxes BELOW the operating line, and the operating-expense favourability was partly attributed by management to timing. Attributing that absorption to an operating mitigation would be bad causal inference.

sensitivities.label: FY2027 gross margin vs the guided 53.72%
sensitivities.unit: bps of FY2027 gross margin (delta vs the guided 5,372bps)
sensitivities.non_linearity: 1bp of FY2027 gross margin = 0.808 of EBIT only while FY2027 revenue is held at the guided 8,080 midpoint; the coefficient is a ratio-on-a-fixed-revenue-base rate, not a joint revenue-and-margin rate, so it must not be scaled together with the q3_fy27_gaap_net_revenue_vs_guide row (that would double-count the same move). This row is the AGGREGATE cost-of-revenue ratio; the content_impairment_to_cost_of_revenue and product_cost_ratio_bps rows are two named components INSIDE it, so the three are alternative cuts and are never additive.
sensitivities.source: TTWO Q2 FY2027 earnings release (8-K Ex. 99.1), 2026-11-09, 'Outlook for Fiscal Year 2027' (revenue 7,980-8,180; cost of revenue 3,679-3,800 -> guided gross margin 53.72% at midpoints) against FY2026 Form 10-K, Item 7 (gross profit 3,809.7 on revenue 6,656.4 = 57.23%). Move size = the company's own revision between its two FY2027 outlooks: TTWO Q1 FY2027 earnings release, 2026-08-07, p.3 (revenue 8,000; cost of revenue 3,598 -> 55.03%) to the 2026-11-09 outlook (53.72%) = -130.6bps.
sensitivities.mitigation_note: A REALISED OFFSET OF 117.1% WAS MEASURED FOR THIS ROW and is recorded here rather than in realised_offset_pct ONLY because the schema caps that field at 100 and the measured value exceeds it. Arithmetic: between the 2026-08-07 and 2026-11-09 FY2027 outlooks, guided gross profit fell 61.5 (4,402.0 to 4,340.5) while guided operating expenses were cut 72.0 (4,160 to 4,088), so guided EBIT ROSE 10.5. Offset = 1 - (+10.5 / -61.5) = 117.1%, equivalently 72.0/61.5 = 117.1%. The CFO's own attribution: the lower gross margin 'is due to the mix of the business, and it's being offset by some changes in the operating expenses' [Q2 FY2027 earnings call transcript, 2026-11-09, Q&A (Schoell / Goldstein)]. TWO QUALIFIERS TRAVEL WITH IT: the offset is measured from two GUIDANCE tables, not from a realised print; and management attributed part of the operating-expense favourability to 'lower personnel and user acquisition costs... some of that was due to timing', and timing is not a durable cost action. The recorded coefficient is therefore the zero-response bound, and the measured 117.1% offset sits beside it in §2 of the markdown.

sensitivities.label: Recurrent consumer spending (in-game spend on titles already shipped) growth vs the guided flat FY2027
sensitivities.unit: percentage points of FY2027 recurrent-consumer-spending growth vs the guided flat
sensitivities.non_linearity: The coefficient is on NET BOOKINGS, not on the EBIT base metric, which is why impact_metric is set: the engine must report the bookings impact and withhold an EBIT level and a margin. The EBIT conversion is NOT QUANTIFIABLE and no proxy may be substituted: the company discloses no cost of revenue, gross profit, operating expense or margin for any content line, and the only directional statement in the pool is that mobile revenue 'generally generates a lower gross margin percentage than our Console or PC revenue', unsized. Base derivation: 78% of FY2026 Net Bookings of 6,721.0 = 5,242.4 (which ties to the guided '65% of Net Bookings' at 5,242.4/8,100 = 64.7%); 1pp = 52.42.
sensitivities.source: TTWO Q2 FY2027 earnings release (8-K Ex. 99.1), 2026-11-09, 'Outlook for Fiscal Year 2027' (recurrent consumer spending flat YoY at 65% of Net Bookings); FY2026 Form 10-K, Item 7 (Net Bookings 6,721.0; recurrent consumer spending 78% share). Move size = the realised Q2 FY27 deviation: Q2 FY2027 earnings call transcript, 2026-11-09, prepared remarks (Goldstein) — 'down 9% for the period compared to our guidance of a 5% decline, driven by NBA 2K'.
sensitivities.mitigation_note: 0% management response assumed — a BOUND, not a forecast (CLAUDE.md §9). Realised offset NOT computable from the pool, for the same reason as the launch-revenue row: the Q2 FY27 absorption cannot be separated into an operating response versus the 57.9 below-the-line income-tax benefit.

sensitivities.label: Impairment of capitalised software development costs and licences charged to cost of revenue (H2 FY2027)
sensitivities.unit: USD m of impairment charged to cost of revenue
sensitivities.non_linearity: A STEP, NOT A SLOPE — the linear scale is a convenience, not the mechanism. The disclosed policy is that 'when we determine that capitalized cost of the title is unlikely to be recovered by product sales, an impairment of software development and license costs capitalized is charged to cost of revenue', so a title judged unrecoverable writes down what the quarterly test says is unrecoverable in one charge. The exposed base is large and growing: 2,149.7 of the non-current balance related to titles that had NOT been released at 2026-03-31 (61.2% of the 3,510.9 of total stockholders' equity at that date), up from 1,815.0 a year earlier. The equivalent unreleased split at 2026-09-30 is NOT disclosed in the 10-Q (only the 2,577.3 total is), so the current unreleased exposure is Not assessable, and the FY2024 109.9 high used as the bear move was measured against a SMALLER unreleased base — making it a floor on the plausible bear, not a cap. This row is a named component inside fy27_gross_margin_bps and is never additive to it.
sensitivities.source: FY2026 Form 10-K, Note 1 (Software Development Costs and Licenses — the 'greater of' amortisation policy, 9-36 month periods, and impairment charged to cost of revenue); FY2026 Form 10-K, Note (Software Development Costs and Licenses — amortisation and impairment table: impairment 109.9 in FY2024, 77.5 in FY2025, (1.0) in FY2026; unreleased-title split 2,149.7 / 1,815.0); Q2 FY2027 Form 10-Q, Item 2 and footnote (43.6 of impairment within cost of revenue for the six months ended 2026-09-30; carried balance 82.4 current + 2,494.9 non-current).
sensitivities.mitigation_note: 0% management response assumed — a BOUND, not a forecast (CLAUDE.md §9). The offset is DELIBERATELY REFUSED on this basis rather than merely unavailable: the only measured offset in this sidecar (117.1%, on fy27_gross_margin_bps) was measured on a MIX-driven gross-profit reduction, and applying it to an impairment would be using a sensitivity across a basis it was not measured on (CLAUDE.md §15). Separately, the contractual fact is not a measurement: business-model 06_value-chain.md records 0% of revenue under a disclosed escalator, indexed-pricing or cost-plus clause, which is a fact about contracts, not a measurement of realised recovery (CLAUDE.md §9).

sensitivities.label: Product costs (platform / app-store fees, payment and physical costs) as a share of revenue
sensitivities.unit: bps of revenue (delta vs the 1,230bps = 12.30% realised in H1 FY2027; + = ratio worsens)
sensitivities.non_linearity: The valid_range is the observed range of the ratio's own ANNUAL moves and it is skewed favourable (-160bps in FY2026 against +50bps in FY2025). NO PLATFORM-FEE INCREASE HAS OCCURRED IN ANY REPORTED PERIOD, so this history does not bound a fee increase: four gatekeepers were each above 10.0% of FY2026 revenue (80.6% top five) and each 'generally ha[s] the discretion to set the amounts of their platform fees and change their platforms' terms of service... at their sole discretion'. A fee increase is an unbounded tail this coefficient's valid_range does not cover. This row is a named component inside fy27_gross_margin_bps and is never additive to it. 1bp = 0.808 of EBIT only while FY2027 revenue is held at the guided 8,080.
sensitivities.source: FY2026 Form 10-K, Item 7 (Cost of revenue — Product costs 863.8 / 13.0% of revenue vs 821.1 / 14.6%); FY2025 Form 10-K, Item 7 (Product costs 756.6 / 14.1% for FY2024); Q2 FY2027 Form 10-Q, Item 2 (Product costs 184.0 / 12.3% for the quarter and 371.8 / 12.3% vs 439.7 / 13.4% for the six months); FY2026 Form 10-K, Item 1 and Item 1A (customer concentration and platform-fee discretion).
sensitivities.mitigation_note: 0% management response assumed — a BOUND, not a forecast (CLAUDE.md §9). A gross-to-net offset for a fee increase cannot be measured because no fee increase has occurred in any reported period. What IS measured, and is recorded here separately rather than as an offset, is the company's demonstrated capacity to move this ratio in its own favour: -160bps across FY2026 (14.6% to 13.0%) and a further -110bps across H1 FY2027 (13.4% to 12.3%), delivered through platform mix (mobile 52.2% to 50.1% of FY2026 revenue) and a direct-to-consumer channel that bypasses the Apple/Google fee [FY2026 10-K Item 7; Q2 FY2027 10-Q Item 2; business-model 06_value-chain.md §2]. That is a realised recovery WITHOUT a fee increase to recover, so it is not the realised offset of this row's bear case. 'No contractual pass-through' is a fact about contracts, not a measurement of realised pass-through.

sensitivities.label: Annual stock-based compensation vs the guided FY2027 $462m
sensitivities.unit: USD m of annual stock-based compensation (delta vs the guided 462)
sensitivities.non_linearity: None in the coefficient — it is 1:1 by construction, because the charge sits inside the guided cost lines (113 in cost of revenue, 349 in operating expenses). What is asymmetric is the valid_range: the favourable leg (-117.3) is the FULL gap down to the trailing-twelve-month run-rate of 344.7 and therefore assumes the entire guided step-up does not happen, which is a favourable BOUND; the adverse leg (+60.1) is +13%, the observed annual spread of the realised series (305.3 to 344.7 = 12.9%). The guide is +51.3% above FY2026's 305.3 actual. Timing interacts with the launch: 96 of the FY2027 total lands in Q3 cost of revenue as the capitalised development costs containing it begin amortising on release, whether or not units sell.
sensitivities.source: TTWO Q2 FY2027 earnings release (8-K Ex. 99.1), 2026-11-09, 'Outlook for Fiscal Year 2027' (462 of stock-based compensation, 113 in cost of revenue and 349 in operating expenses) and 'Fiscal Third Quarter Ending December 31, 2026' (96 in Q3 cost of revenue); Q2 FY2027 Form 10-Q, Item 2 footnotes (90.0 in the quarter across four lines); FY2026 Form 10-K, p.66 (305.3 in FY2026; 324.0 FY2025; 335.6 FY2024; 317.8 FY2023); trailing-twelve-month 344.7 per earnings 06_earnings-quality.md §1.
sensitivities.mitigation_note: not_applicable because THIS ROW IS THE RESPONSE CHANNEL: stock-based compensation is set by the company's own grant decisions, so there is no separate management response to hold at zero. It is a real cost of paying staff, not an accounting artefact — the share count rose from 177.1m outstanding at 2025-03-31 to 187.2m at 2026-09-30.

sensitivities.label: US dollar against all currencies (+ = USD stronger) — the company's own published Item 7A sensitivity
sensitivities.unit: % move in the value of the USD against all currencies
sensitivities.non_linearity: SYMMETRIC BY DISCLOSURE — the company states both directions explicitly (a 10.0% USD rise cuts revenue 4.0%; a 10.0% fall raises it 4.0%), so this is the one row with no asymmetry. The coefficient is on GAAP NET REVENUE, not on the EBIT base metric, which is why impact_metric is set: the engine must report the revenue impact and withhold an EBIT level and a margin. The EBIT conversion is NOT QUANTIFIABLE and no proxy may be substituted: the company's own next sentence is 'In our opinion, a substantial portion of this fluctuation would be offset by cost of revenue and operating expenses incurred in local currency', and it does NOT size 'a substantial portion'. The four disclosed realised periods are too small and sign-inconsistent to measure it: FY2026 revenue +9.9 but EBIT +14.2 (gross profit +45.4 less operating expenses +31.2) — an AMPLIFICATION, not an offset; Q2 FY27 revenue -0.6 and EBIT -0.6 — a 0% offset on a 0.6 move; Q1 FY27 revenue +0.6 but EBIT -1.0 — a sign flip. For scale, the realised effect on revenue has been 9.9 or less in EVERY disclosed period, against this +/-323.2 hypothetical bound. Derivation: 4.0% of the FY2027 guided 8,080 = 323.2 per 10% USD move = 32.32 per 1%.
sensitivities.source: FY2026 Form 10-K, Item 7A (Foreign Currency Exchange Rate Risk) — 'a hypothetical 10.0% increase in the value of the U.S. dollar against all currencies would decrease revenues by 4.0%, while a hypothetical 10.0% decrease in the value of the U.S. dollar against all currencies would increase revenues by 4.0%', measured on a year in which 40.8% of revenue was non-US; restated identically in Q2 FY2027 Form 10-Q, Item 3 and Q1 FY2027 Form 10-Q, Item 3 (40.0% non-US). Realised effects: FY2026 Form 10-K, Item 7 and Q2/Q1 FY2027 Form 10-Q, Item 2.
sensitivities.mitigation_note: 0% response assumed on the revenue line — a BOUND, not a forecast (CLAUDE.md §9), and the coefficient is explicitly GROSS of the company's own stated but unsized local-currency cost offset. disclosed_positions was CONSIDERED AND REJECTED: the coefficient is NOT position-inclusive. The hedge book ($748.7 to sell and $327.8 to buy foreign currency at 2026-09-30, up from $349.2 and $140.3 at 2026-03-31, all under one year) covers 'non-functional currency denominated cash balances and intercompany funding loans... accounts receivable and... accounts payable', is 'not designated as hedging instruments', and its gains and losses are recorded in Interest and other, net — BELOW the revenue line this coefficient is measured on. The company says so plainly: 'Our hedging programs are designed to reduce, but do not entirely eliminate, the effect of currency exchange rate movements.' Realised offset not computable (see non_linearity: the one computable period gives a 0% offset on a 0.6 move, and the other periods amplify or flip sign).
